# Tailwind Theme Customizer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Tailwind CSS

## Overview

Customizes Tailwind CSS themes with custom colors, typography, spacing scales, and dark mode configuration for brand consistency

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [tailwind-theme-customizer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
tailwind-theme-customizer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@tailwind-theme-customizer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Extend theme with custom colors and spacing scales
- Configure typography with custom font families and sizes
- Implement dark mode with class or media strategy
- Create custom design tokens mapped to Tailwind config

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Theme Configuration**: Official theme customization documentation
- **Dark Mode**: Class-based and media-based dark mode patterns
- **Design Tokens**: Mapping design system tokens to Tailwind config
